hubTrigger.claim: Xiaomi planned substantially more startup investment in appliances/hardware to expand its smart-home ecosystem.

evidence.claim: 2014 revenue exceeded RMB140bn and net profit exceeded RMB10bn; company had already established a smart-home research institute, M-Smart strategy, e-commerce platform and open ecosystem.
About 30 smart-product categories/prototypes and cloud/app infrastructure were already built; cooperation included Alibaba, JD, Huawei and others; Xiaomi strategic cooperation was signed in Dec 2014.
Midea publicly released its smart-home system white paper and displayed broad smart-product coverage, confirming active execution.

risks: Xiaomi/Midea cooperation predated the Jan-16 hub story
